_comment: Which folders each Flatpak app may still reach once its whole-home or
whole-filesystem access is taken away. Read by the flatpak-portals privacy
This file is the template. Put your own copy at
~/.config/tkoc/flatpak-access.json -- outside the checkout, so it survives
`tkoc update` and is never committed -- and tkoc reads that one instead.
An app listed here loses home and host access and is granted exactly the
folders given: ~/path, /path, or an xdg- name such as xdg-documents, with
:ro for read-only. An empty list grants nothing; file dialogs that go
through the portal still work. An app not listed is reported, never
changed, because tkoc cannot know which folder it needs.
Changes take effect the next time the app starts. Undo one app with
